ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_week.telecomPrice * 100 / t_week.operatorPrice, 1), '%') ,'0%') weekTelecomPricePercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_week.radioTVPrice * 100 / t_week.operatorPrice, 1), '%') ,'0%') weekRadioTVPricePercent, ifnull(t_week.unicomNum, 0) weekUnicomNum, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_week.unicomNum * 100 / t_week.operatorNum, 1), '%') ,'0%') weekUnicomNumPercent, weekTelecomNumPercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_week.radioTVNum * 100 / t_week.operatorNum, 1), '%'),'0%') weekRadioTVNumPercent, ifnull(t_week.operatorPrice - t_week.unicomPrice,0) as weekLostPrice, monthOperatorNum, ifnull(t_month.unicomPrice , 0) as monthUnicomPrice, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_month.unicomPrice * 100 / t_month.operatorPrice, 0), '%'),'0%') monthPricePercent, ifnull(ROUND(t_month.unicomPrice * 100 / t_month.operatorPrice, 0) - ROUND(t_last_month.unicomPrice * 100 / t_last_month.operatorPrice, 0),'0') monthUnicomPPPrice, ifnull(t_month.unicomNum, 0) as monthUnicomNum, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_month.unicomNum * 100 / t_month.operatorNum, 0), '%') ,'0%') monthUnicomNumPercent, ifnull(ROUND(t_month.unicomNum * 100 / t_month.operatorNum, 0) - ROUND(t_last_month.unicomNum * 100 / t_last_month.operatorNum, 0),'0') monthUnicomPPNum, t_year.publicPrice as yearPublicPrice, t_year.publicNum as yearPublicNum, t_year.operatorPrice as yearOperatorPrice, CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.operatorPrice * 100 / t_year.publicPrice, 0), '%') yearOperatorPricePercent, t_year.operatorNum as yearOperatorNum, CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.operatorNum * 100 / t_year.publicNum, 0), '%') yearOperatorNumPercent, ifnull(t_year.unicomPrice,0) as yearUnicomPrice, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.unicomPrice * 100 / t_year.operatorPrice, 0), '%'),0) yearUnicomPricePercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.mobilePrice * 100 / t_year.operatorPrice, 0), '%'),0) yearMobilePricePercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.telecomPrice * 100 / t_year.operatorPrice, 0), '%'),0) yearTelecomPricePercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.radioTVPrice * 100 / t_year.operatorPrice, 0), '%'),0) yearRadioTVPricePercent, ifnull(t_year.unicomNum,0) as yearUnicomNum, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.unicomNum * 100 / t_year.operatorNum, 0), '%') ,0) yearUnicomNumPercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.mobileNum * 100 / t_year.operatorNum, 0), '%') ,0) yearMobileNumPercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.telecomNum * 100 / t_year.operatorNum, 0), '%'),0) yearTelecomNumPercent, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.radioTVNum * 100 / t_year.operatorNum, 0), '%'),0) yearRadioTVNumPercent from (select '合计' as city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, count(1) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '移动' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as mobilePrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '移动' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mobileNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as telecomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as telecomNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '广电' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as radioTVPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '广电' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as radioTVNum, SUM(CASE WHEN bc.id is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unBizNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b left join chatbi.bid_customer bc on b.customer_id = bc.id where b.province=#{province} and (b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电') and b.publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime} ) t_week join (select '合计' as city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, count(1) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum, SUM(CASE WHEN bc.id is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unBizNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b left join chatbi.bid_customer bc on b.customer_id = bc.id where b.province=#{province} and (b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电') and b.publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime} ) t_month on t_week.city = t_month.city join (select '合计' as city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, count(1) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b where b.province=#{province} and (b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电') and b.publish_time between date_sub(#{monthStartDate}, INTERVAL 1 month) and date_sub(#{monthEndDate}, INTERVAL 1 month) ) t_last_month on t_month.city = t_last_month.city join (select '合计' as city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as publicPrice, count(1) as publicNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '移动' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as mobilePrice, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as telecomPrice, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '广电' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as radioTVPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '移动' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as mobileNum, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as telecomNum, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '广电' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as radioTVNum, SUM(CASE WHEN bc.id is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unBizNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b left join chatbi.bid_customer bc on b.customer_id = bc.id where b.province=#{province} and b.publish_time between #{yearStartDate} and #{yearEndDate} ) t_year on t_month.city = t_year.city

weekUnicomPrice, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_week.unicomPrice * 100 / t_week.operatorPrice, 0), '%'), '-') weekUnicomPricePercent, ifnull(t_week.unicomNum , 0) weekUnicomNum, - t_week.unicomNum , 0) AS weekLostNum, ifnull(t_week.unBizNum , 0) AS weekUnBizNum, ifnull(t_month.OperatorPrice , 0) AS monthOperatorPrice, ifnull(t_month.operatorNum , 0) AS monthOperatorNum, ifnull(t_month.unicomPrice , 0) AS monthUnicomPrice, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_month.unicomPrice * 100 / t_month.operatorPrice, 0), '%'), '-') monthPricePercent, ifnull(ROUND(t_month.unicomPrice * 100 / t_month.operatorPrice, 0) - ROUND(t_last_month.unicomPrice * 100 / t_last_month.operatorPrice, 0) ,0) monthUnicomPPPrice, ifnull(t_month.unicomNum , 0) AS monthUnicomNum, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_month.unicomNum * 100 / t_month.operatorNum, 0), '%'), '-') monthUnicomNumPercent, ifnull(ROUND(t_month.unicomNum * 100 / t_month.operatorNum, 0) - ROUND(t_last_month.unicomNum * 100 / t_last_month.operatorNum, 0),0) monthUnicomPPNum, ifnull(t_year.publicPrice , 0) AS yearPublicPrice, ifnull(t_year.publicNum , 0) AS yearPublicNum, ifnull(t_year.operatorPrice , 0) AS yearOperatorPrice, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.operatorPrice * 100 / t_year.publicPrice, 0), '%'), '-') yearOperatorPricePercent, ifnull(t_year.operatorNum,0) AS yearOperatorNum, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.operatorNum * 100 / t_year.publicNum, 0), '%'), '-') yearOperatorNumPercent, ifnull(t_year.unicomPrice,0) AS yearUnicomPrice, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.unicomPrice * 100 / t_year.operatorPrice, 0), '%') , '-') yearUnicomPricePercent, ifnull(t_year.unicomNum,0) AS yearUnicomNum, ifnull(CONCAT(ROUND(t_year.unicomNum * 100 / t_year.operatorNum, 0), '%'), '-') yearUnicomNumPercent from chatbi.bid_dict_data dict left join (select b.city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, count(1) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum, SUM(CASE WHEN bc.id is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unBizNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b left join chatbi.bid_customer bc on b.customer_id = bc.id where b.province=#{province} and (b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电') and b.publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime} group by b.city) t_week on t_week.city = convert(dict.value using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci and dict_type = 'bid_statistics_city' left join (select b.city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, count(1) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum, SUM(CASE WHEN bc.id is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unBizNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b left join chatbi.bid_customer bc on b.customer_id = bc.id where b.province=#{province} and (b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电') and b.publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime} group by b.city) t_month on t_week.city = t_month.city left join (select b.city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, count(1) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b where b.province=#{province} and (b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电') and b.publish_time between date_sub(#{monthStartDate}, INTERVAL 1 month) and date_sub(#{monthEndDate}, INTERVAL 1 month) group by b.city) t_last_month on t_month.city = t_last_month.city left join (select b.city, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(ifnull(b.win_bid_price, 0)) / 10000), 0) as publicPrice, count(1) as publicNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as operatorPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '电信' or b.operator = '联通' or b.operator = '移动' or b.operator = '广电' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as operatorNum, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN b.win_bid_price ELSE 0 END) / 10000), 0) as unicomPrice, SUM(CASE WHEN b.operator = '联通' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unicomNum, SUM(CASE WHEN bc.id is null THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unBizNum from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid b left join chatbi.bid_customer bc on b.customer_id = bc.id where b.province=#{province} and b.publish_time between #{yearStartDate} and #{yearEndDate} group by b.city) t_year on t_month.city = t_year.city WHERE dict.dict_type = 'bid_statistics_city' order by monthUnicomPPPrice desc

select p.city, p.num + b.num as totalNum, p.bidding_budget + b.bidding_budget as totalBudget, pknow.num + bknow.num as totalKnowNum, pknow.bidding_budget + bknow.bidding_budget as totalKnowBudget, CONCAT(ROUND(ifnull(pknow.num + bknow.num,0) * 100 / (p.num + b.num), 0), '%') as totalNumPercent, p.num as purchaseNum, p.bidding_budget as purchaseBudget, pknow.num as purchaseKnowNum, pknow.bidding_budget as purchaseKnowBudget, CONCAT(ROUND(ifnull(pknow.num,0) * 100 / p.num, 0), '%') as purchaseNumPercent, b.num biddingNum, b.bidding_budget biddingBudget, bknow.num biddingKnowNum, bknow.bidding_budget biddingKnowBudget, CONCAT(ROUND(ifnull(bknow.num,0) * 100 / b.num, 0), '%') as biddingNumPercent from (select '合计' city, count(1) num, round(bidding_budget/10000, 0) bidding_budget from chatbi.bid_biz_purchase_intention where province=#{province} and publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime}) p join (select '合计' city, count(1) num, round(bidding_budget/10000, 0) bidding_budget from chatbi.bid_biz_purchase_intention t join chatbi.bid_business a where a.id = t.bid_bus_id and t.province=#{province} and t.publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime}) pknow on p.city = pknow.city join (select '合计' city, count(1) num, round(bidding_budget/10000, 0) bidding_budget from chatbi.bid_biz_purchase_intention where province=#{province} and publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime}) b on p.city = b.city join (select '合计' city, count(1) num, round(bidding_budget/10000, 0) bidding_budget from chatbi.bid_biz_bidding t join chatbi.bid_business a where a.id = t.bid_bus_id and t.province=#{province} and t.publish_time between #{weekStartTime} and #{weekEndTime}) bknow on p.city = bknow.city

select '合计' as city, ifnull(purchaseNum,0) + ifnull(biddingNum,0) as totalNum, ifnull(purchaseBudget,0) + ifnull(biddingBudget,0) as totalBudget, 0 as totalKnowNum, 0 as totalKnowBudget, '0%' as totalNumPercent, purchaseNum, purchaseBudget, 0 as purchaseKnowNum, 0 as purchaseKnowBudget, '0%' as purchaseNumPercent, biddingNum, biddingBudget, 0 as biddingKnowNum, 0 as biddingKnowBudget, '0%' as biddingNumPercent, ifnull(purchaseOver300Num,0) as purchaseOver300Num, ifnull(biddingOver300Num,0) as biddingOver300Num from ( select count(1) as purchaseNum, round(ifnull(sum(bidding_budget),0)/10000, 0) as purchaseBudget, count(case when bidding_budget >= 3000000 then 1 end) as purchaseOver300Num from chatbi.bid_biz_purchase_intention where province=#{province} and publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} ) p, ( select count(1) as biddingNum, round(ifnull(sum(bidding_budget),0)/10000, 0) as biddingBudget, count(case when bidding_budget >= 3000000 then 1 end) as biddingOver300Num from chatbi.bid_biz_bidding where province=#{province} and publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} ) b

select dict.label as city, ifnull(p.num,0) as purchaseNum, ifnull(p.budget,0) as purchaseBudget, 0 as purchaseKnowNum, 0 as purchaseKnowBudget, '0%' as purchaseNumPercent from chatbi.bid_dict_data dict left join ( select city, count(1) as num, round(ifnull(sum(bidding_budget),0)/10000, 0) as budget from chatbi.bid_biz_purchase_intention where province=#{province} and publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} group by city ) p on convert(dict.value using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = p.city where dict_type = 'bid_statistics_city' and dict.province=#{province} order by dict.sort asc

select dict.label as city, ifnull(b.num,0) as biddingNum, ifnull(b.budget,0) as biddingBudget, 0 as biddingKnowNum, 0 as biddingKnowBudget, '0%' as biddingNumPercent from chatbi.bid_dict_data dict left join ( select city, count(1) as num, round(ifnull(sum(bidding_budget),0)/10000, 0) as budget from chatbi.bid_biz_bidding where province=#{province} and publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} group by city ) b on convert(dict.value using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = b.city where dict_type = 'bid_statistics_city' and dict.province=#{province} order by dict.sort asc

select group_concat(city separator '、') as cities from ( select distinct p.city, d.sort from chatbi.bid_biz_purchase_intention p left join chatbi.bid_dict_data d on convert(p.city using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = d.value and d.dict_type = 'bid_statistics_city' where p.province=#{province} and p.publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and p.publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} and p.bidding_budget >= 3000000 order by sort asc ) t

select group_concat(city separator '、') as cities from ( select distinct b.city, d.sort from chatbi.bid_biz_bidding b left join chatbi.bid_dict_data d on convert(b.city using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci = d.value and d.dict_type = 'bid_statistics_city' where b.province=#{province} and b.publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and b.publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} and b.bidding_budget >= 3000000 order by sort asc ) t

select city, tenderer, industry, project_name as projectName, round(ifnull(win_bid_price,0)/10000, 0) as winBidPrice, operator from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid where province=#{province} and publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and publish_time <= #{publishEndTime} order by win_bid_price desc

select '合计' as city, count(1) as totalNum, round(ifnull(sum(win_bid_price),0)/10000, 0) as totalPrice, sum(case when operator in ('联通','移动','电信','广电') then 1 else 0 end) as operatorNum, round(ifnull(sum(case when operator in ('联通','移动','电信','广电') then win_bid_price else 0 end),0)/10000, 0) as operatorPrice, round(ifnull(sum(case when operator = '联通' then win_bid_price else 0 end),0)/10000, 0) as unicomPrice, CONCAT(ROUND(ifnull(sum(case when operator = '联通' then win_bid_price else 0 end),0) * 100 / ifnull(sum(case when operator in ('联通','移动','电信','广电') then win_bid_price else 0 end),1), 0), '%') as unicomPercent from chatbi.bid_biz_win_bid where province=#{province} and publish_time >= #{publishStartTime} and publish_time <= #{publishEndTime}
